description: Election Commission - Q. Ciril Keegal was Selected as the Member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) due to resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the nomination and declaration of an elected member to fill a vacant seat, which falls under the Elections classification (Type 7).
